sourceNote: Named people outside the system. memberLinks are the owner's: which alters have a special link to each person.

people.name: Sarah
people.role: The character's parent: a single mother, minister (pastor) of a programmed Friends church in the USA
people.description: Well-meaning but absent, and neglectful to the point of harm: she puts the congregation before raising her child. The game never shows her side.

people.name: Mira Smith
people.role: The prologue's guide: a kind older Friend in Sarah's church
people.description: Tries to be there for Maya as a child, and fails: at 5 she finds Maya forgotten at church; at 8 she raises her worries with Sarah and backs down; by 11 Maya hides how bad things are, and Mira moves away. She falls ill and dies before Maya is 15, and never comes back. Sarah mentions her death in passing in the car.

people.name: Mark
people.role: Ex 1: the Christian ex
people.description: Protestant. A college classmate in Maya's junior year at the University of Illinois. He dates Axel, who starts fronting that year and comes out as a trans man as the body. Mark never learns about the system; it ends when Maya comes back (owner). From Indianapolis.

memberLinks.link: dated Mark, as a trans man

people.name: Adeena
people.role: Ex 2: Maya's girlfriend for two and a half years (Chapter 2). Conservative, later Hasidic; married Michael after they broke up
people.description: 27 when they meet at the museum (she's the registrar). Stern and serious, with a heart of gold. Every Friday she lights the Shabbat candles and Maya covers her eyes with her for the blessing. Her look: the owner designs it.

people.name: Michael
people.role: Adeena's husband, whom she met after the breakup. Maya hears of the wedding in Chapter 6, from an old friend from work.

people.name: Mr. Carter
people.role: A single dad in Sarah's church, present for his children
people.description: The family Maya envies: a single parent like Sarah, but there for his kids. Maya watches them from afar.

people.name: Thomas
people.role: Mr. Carter's son, much older than Maya

people.name: Reneé
people.role: Mr. Carter's daughter, much older than Maya; later, Maya's friend
people.description: Watched from afar in the prologue. As a child she used crutches; as an adult she uses a manual wheelchair. She overheard Mira raising her worries with Sarah (Sunday 2, Maya 8). Years later (chapter 4 or 5) she and adult Maya meet up to talk about being queer and ex-religious: Reneé is an out bisexual and has left Sarah's church, but still identifies as Quaker. She tells Maya what she overheard.

people.name: Rebecca
people.role: Maya's only friend in First Day School
people.description: Kind, but prefers other kids over Maya. Her parents are never named; she calls them "my mom" and "my dad".

people.name: Jamie
people.role: A child in First Day School whom Rebecca prefers

people.name: Justin
people.role: A child in First Day School whom Rebecca prefers

people.name: Will
people.role: A child in First Day School whom Rebecca prefers

people.name: Miss Eloise
people.role: The First Day School (Sunday school) teacher

people.name: Mrs. Hines
people.role: An elder / board member who keeps Sarah busy

people.name: Mr. Jones
people.role: An elder / board member who keeps Sarah busy

people.name: Miss Susan
people.role: Maya's school teacher (remembered only, never seen)

people.name: Selene
people.role: Maya's classmate at college in Illinois; the first person through whom Maya meets Wicca

people.name: Tanya
people.role: The coven elder (42, they/them): kind but strict. Runs an open, eclectic teaching coven with public sabbat circles; the Prelude's guide
people.description: Stays in Maya's life for the whole game: mostly texts and emails, meeting up less often as time goes by, and a final meeting at the end of the game (owner).

people.name: Gracie
people.role: Chapter 1's guide: a young nun, still in training (25, she/her). Very bright, peppy and excited about her faith, never in a harmful way

people.name: Father Key
people.role: Chapter 1.5's guide: the priest at St. Luke's, Mark's queer-friendly Episcopal church. 31, he/him. Kind to Axel, invites him for holidays, not in touch consistently.

people.name: Cassie
people.role: Mark's mother, in Indianapolis: Christmas and Easter at the family's Methodist church.

people.name: Rabbi Abe
people.role: Chapter 2's guide: the rabbi at Adeena's Conservative synagogue. Runs the interfaith couples' meetup (keruv). Vital and refreshing.

people.name: Eudora Jones
people.role: A curator at The Field Museum, where Maya is a tour guide and Adeena the registrar. Shouts on stressful days.

people.name: Ruth
people.role: Adeena's mother, Reform.

people.name: Lee
people.role: Adeena's uncle: secular, Humanistic Judaism; comes to every seder 'for the people'.

people.name: Effie
people.role: Adeena's cousin, Modern Orthodox; stays Maya's friend after the breakup.

people.name: Grandma
people.role: Adeena's grandmother, whose family came from Morocco: Sephardi traditions, the Mimouna (Claude's guess).

people.name: Hannah
people.role: Adeena's friend who leads a Reconstructionist havurah in her living room.

people.name: Tigist
people.role: Beta Israel (Ethiopian Jewish) community member who welcomes Maya at a Sigd celebration in Chicago (owner: keep the name).

people.name: Christie
people.role: Maya's friend at The Field Museum, another tour guide: kind, funny, covers for her. Years later (Chapter 6) she's the one who tells Maya about Adeena's wedding.

people.name: Angie
people.role: Maya's therapist (35, she/her), found by Tanya. Knows about dissociation. Only ever says 'a dissociative disorder', never a label.

people.name: Pasang Lhamo Sherpa
people.role: Chapter 3's guide: the temple-stay host (about 55, she/her). Runs her family's guest house behind a monastery in Boudha, Kathmandu; her brother-in-law is a monk there. Practical and motherly; walks the kora around the stupa with Maya at dawn.

people.name: Teacher
people.role: The teacher at the 10-day silent Vipassana course at Dharma Shringa (unnamed).

people.name: Chaplain Amal
people.role: Chapter 4's guide: a Muslim (Sunni) chaplain at the psychiatric day program (owner: Chaplain Amal, Maya's age, she/her). Gives spiritual care to anyone, of any faith or none; mostly listens; brings dates.

people.name: Sawsan
people.role: Another patient at the day program (owner's name; 30s, she/her): Palestinian American, Sunni Muslim. Prays in the quiet room and counts her grandmother's tasbih (prayer beads) from Nablus; invites them to iftar (her mom's maqluba).

people.name: Fadi
people.role: A Sufi teacher who leads a Thursday-night dhikr, Amal's friend (owner's name; 60s, he/him). Shia (owner), Lebanese American, from Beirut; prays on a clay turbah from Karbala; his circle welcomes Sunni and Shia alike.

people.name: Mangala Tai
people.role: Chapter 5's guide (owner): Mangala Joshi, 62, she/her, the priest (a purohita) at a community mandir on Seattle's Eastside; called Mangala Tai. Maharashtrian; learned the chants listening at the door while her father taught her brothers; trained in Pune in her thirties.

people.name: Priya
people.role: Maya's colleague in collections at the Burke Museum in Seattle (owner: Priya; she/her); invites her to her family's temple.

people.name: Lakshmi
people.role: Priya's mother (owner's name): runs the Saturday garland table at the temple; Diwali lamps at home (she/her).

people.name: Grandma June
people.role: Maya's grandmother, Sarah's mother (CLAUDE'S GUESS: name and details, owner to change)
people.description: A Quaker, quieter than Sarah. She died in 2002, when Maya was four. Maya remembers a cardigan, peppermints, and being held through a whole meeting for worship.

people.name: Grandpa Walter
people.role: Maya's grandfather, Sarah's father (CLAUDE'S GUESS: name and details, owner to change)
people.description: A Quaker farmer near Iowa City who died before Maya was born. Maya has his photo (a man squinting into the sun beside a tractor) and his name.

people.name: Dot
people.role: Works the till at The Circle and reads tea leaves after Thursday class (CLAUDE'S GUESS: name to come from the owner)
people.description: About seventy, she/her, half-moon glasses, never without a teapot. Reads cups for anyone who asks, and laughs at the gloomy bits.

people.name: Bibi Harjit
people.role: Chapter 6's guide (Claude's guess, placeholder name): Harjit Kaur, about 70, she/her, has run the Sunday langar kitchen at the gurdwara in Kent for thirty-five years; from Ludhiana; came every day after her husband died. 'Chardi kala.'

people.name: Gurleen
people.role: Maya's colleague at the Burke Museum (Claude's guess, placeholder name), she/her; Sikh, cuts her hair, goes to her grandmother's gurdwara in Kent; her brother Arjan took amrit.

people.name: Lin Daozhang
people.role: Chapter 7's guide (owner: a Zhengyi Daoist priest, married, an older man; name and story Claude's placeholders): Lin Daozhang ("Daozhang", Dao master: the respectful title for a Zhengyi priest), 68, he/him, from six generations of priests in Tainan; in Seattle since 1994; taxes on weekdays, the temple's rites on weekends at Fu Shan Temple.

people.name: Auntie Mei
people.role: Master Lin's wife (Claude's placeholder), 65, she/her; runs the temple's incense, oranges and volunteers.

people.name: Bríd
people.role: Chapter 8's guide (owner: an older Irish woman who leads a grove; name and story Claude's placeholders): Bríd Kenny, 66, she/her, sheep farmer below the Hill of Uisneach, a retired national school teacher, an Irish speaker; leads Fuinseog Grove; Tanya's friend since 2004.

people.name: Miss Ella
people.role: Chapter 9's guide (owner: a teacher, 30, she/her, raised religious and left, who built an after-school club because nobody did it for her). Teaches at the middle school in Arcata; a humanist, training as a humanist celebrant (Claude's guess).

people.name: Maisie
people.role: Chapter 9 (owner: 13, she/her): a girl at the after-school club who goes quiet and 'floaty' and doesn't answer her name. Lives with her grandmother (Claude's guess).
